**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the real use case, not just the feature.

**Proposed approach**
How you imagine this working, if you have a concrete idea.

**Does this fit the project's hard constraints?**
Check `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s "Hard constraints" section (no Swift/AppKit,
React+TS frontend only, zero network calls after model download, zero paid
resources, no accounts/payments, toggle hotkey, auto-detected language). If
your idea conflicts with one of these, say so explicitly — it doesn't
automatically disqualify the idea, but it needs to be discussed before any
code gets written.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything else you thought about.
